# Purgonorgo Isle — The Hub

Every custom service NPC lives on a single island plaza on **Purgonorgo Isle** (zone 44). Reach it any time with the **`!hub`** command — the old `!leaf`, `!lib`, and `!gmhome` commands land here too.
